title.narrative: ECOWAS has contributed to increased number of female candidates holding elective positions in the region
Percentage of women standing for elections following engagement in ECOWAS capacity development activities

target.value: 70% women standing for elections following engagement in ECOWAS capacity development activities.

actual.value: The percentage of women standing for elections following engagement in ECOWAS capacity development activities remains below 70%. Example: in Senegal the 2024 parliamentary election saw 73 women elected to the 165 member parliamentarians, accounting for about 44%representation. This marks the highest percentage in West Africa and reflects the impact of sustained gender advocacy and quota system. However in Nigeria, women s representation remained notably low with only 4 percent of parliamentarians highlightingpersistent challenge in achieving gender parity
